Name: Stock Market Life - Pelican Town Stock Exchange
Author: XI221
Description:
[size=5][b]Stock Market Life[/b][/size]
Mayor Lewis writes that the Pelican Town Stock Exchange has opened, and sends you a [b]stock ticker desk[/b] (the game's own radio desk, with a little market chart on its screen). Put it anywhere in your house and right-click it.

[size=4][b]Two boards, eight companies[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Pelican Town[/b]: Pierre's General Store, JojaMart, Willy's Fish Shop, Clint's Blacksmith. Their share prices nudge real prices in their shops (up to ±10%, configurable): seeds and crop prices follow Pierre, fish follow Willy, ore follows Clint.[/*]
[*][b]Zuzu City[/b]: Zuzu City Media (The Queen of Sauce), Ferngill Bonds (barely move, pay interest every season), Ferngill Arms (follows the war with the Gotoro Empire), and Qi Group (the wildest of all - lists once you open Mr. Qi's Walnut Room).[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Prices follow your game[/b][/size]
A new season sells seeds, rain brings anglers, a deeper mine helps Clint, restoring the Community Center hurts Joja, and shipping more crops than usual lifts Pierre. On top of that the market has a mood of its own and the odd unexplained swing.

[size=4][b]Rumors: true or false?[/b][/size]
Every morning the [b]Pelican Times[/b] arrives: headline, yesterday's market, the rumor mill, today's shop prices, news around town and from Zuzu City, Gus's tips at the saloon, and tomorrow's weather.
Rumors come from saloon talk (rarely true), the grapevine, or insiders (usually true). Whether a rumor is true is decided the moment it appears - you only find out a few days later when it's confirmed or denied. Some news breaks with no warning at all, and some stories have sequels. 50+ stories built on Stardew characters and places.

[size=4][b]Your brokerage account[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Move money between your wallet and your account, or auto-deposit part of each night's shipping income.[/*]
[*]Borrow against your account (daily interest). If your assets fall to 1.3x your loan, everything is sold - a margin call. Anything still owed is taken from half of each day's shipping income.[/*]
[*]Season dividends for shares you've held through the last week of the season.[/*]
[*]Limit up / limit down (±10% a day): can't buy at limit up, can't sell at limit down.[/*]
[*][b]Cash out[/b] sells everything, repays your loan and returns the money to your wallet - [b]do this before uninstalling[/b], or the money in your account goes with the mod.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Balance[/b][/size]
Simulated over hundreds of in-game years: sensible play makes roughly 10-20% a year, blindly chasing rumors loses money, and even knowing every rumor's truth in advance only makes about 60%. Farming stays your real job; the market is a side hobby.

[size=4][b]Settings[/b][/size]
With Generic Mod Config Menu: turn price linkage on/off and set its range, trading fee, loan interest, and max shares per company.

[size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Single player (in multiplayer only the host can trade).[/*]
[*]Everything in the exchange is fictional and for entertainment only. Not investment advice. 18+.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
SMAPI 4.0+. Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu. English and Chinese.

[size=4][b]中文[/b][/size]
韭菜人生：鹈鹕镇开了证券交易所。刘易斯来信送你一台「行情收报台」，摆在家里右键打开。鹈鹕镇板块有皮埃尔、Joja、威利、克林特，股价会温和地改它们店里的价钱；祖祖城板块有传媒、国债、军工和齐先生集团。股价跟着你游戏里真实发生的事走，每天早上看《鹈鹕时报》，自己判断风声真假。可以借钱炒，亏多了会爆仓。卸载前记得在收报台里点「清仓转出」。游戏内虚构娱乐，不构成投资建议，未满 18 岁严禁使用。

Manifest.Description: 韭菜人生 / Stock Market Life: a stock market for Pelican Town. Pierre's, Joja, Willy, Clint and a few Zuzu City companies are listed; prices follow what happens in your game, rumors may be true or false, and you can borrow (watch out for margin calls). Trade from the stock ticker desk Lewis mails you.
